abstract: Although sacrococcygeal teratoma is a rare and potentially malignant tumor, 10 cases were documented during a 5-year period at the University of Toronto Perinatal Complex. Diagnosis was made in the six cases in which prenatal ultrasound examination was performed. One patient with twins elected to terminate the pregnancy at 19 weeks. In three of the cases diagnosed prenatally, serial ultrasound was performed. There was a 75% cesarean section rate. In all cases diagnosed prenatally, the large tumor size affected the mode of delivery. In the four cases without prenatal diagnosis, two infants were delivered vaginally, and two were delivered abdominally for obstetric reasons. There was one case of neonatal morbidity where tumor vascularity and rupture resulted in hypovolemic shock. All tumors were resected and found to be benign. A plan of management is recommended and, with appropriate obstetric and pediatric care, a good outcome can be anticipated in most cases.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫は稀で潜在的に悪性となりうる腫瘍であるが、トロント大学周産期センターで5年間に10例が確認された。出生前超音波検査が行われた6例で診断された。このうち3例では経時的な超音波検査が施行された。腫瘍が大きいため、帝王切開率は75%であった。出生前に診断された全例で、腫瘍の大きさが分娩方法の選択に影響した。出生前診断されなかった4例のうち、2例は経腟分娩、2例は産科的理由により経腹分娩された。腫瘍の血行過多と破裂により出血性ショックを生じた新生児の罹患が1例あった。全腫瘍が切除され、良性と判明した。管理方針を提案し、適切な産科および小児科管理により、ほとんどの症例で良好な転帰が期待できると結論づけた。
